curriculum_sentences: Injiniyan ya gina ingantaccen tsarin rarraba bayanai mai matuƙar inganci.
Ɓaliban sun fahimci hadadden tsarin cibiyar sadarwa na jijiyoyi sosai.
Mun aiwatar da yarjejeniyar ƙwaƙwalwar ajiya mai aiki a lokaci guda cikin nasara.
Farfesa ya yi cikakken bayani kan ƙa'idojin ilimin nahawu.
Ƙungiyar bincike ta buga wata muhimmiyar maƙala kan fasahar basirar wucin gadi.
Mai tsara manhaja ya inganta dukkan hanyoyin sarrafa bayanai.
Basirar wucin gadi tana nazarin rubutu a cikin harsuna da yawa daidai.
Ƙungiyar ci gaba ta kammala dukkan gwaje-gwajen haɗin kai cikin nasara.
Hanyar ƙwaƙwalwa mai sauri tana tabbatar da daidaiton bayanai a ainihin lokaci.
Mun gudanar da tsauraran gwaje-gwaje don tabbatar da ƙarfin tsarin.
Masanin kimiyya ya gwada saurin da ingancin sabon lissafin.
Yara sun karanta littattafai masu kyau a dakin karatu.
Yanayin yau yana da kyau sosai kuma yana da sanyi.
Manoma sun fara girbin hatsi a gonakinsu.
